# truenas_vm_reset (Action)

Hard-resets a VM (vm.reset) — the equivalent of a power-cycle. Requires TrueNAS 27.0 or newer.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) ID of the VM to reset (truenas_vm.<name>.id).
